justified.note: The walk returns null before it can fail, so kind is never given null and the test is never true.
The pg_type query selects four columns and each goes through String, so delim is never undefined and the default is never read.
Both groups of the MODULE pattern take part in every match, so neither group is undefined and neither default is read.
With no import found the loop over found adds no finding, so the early return only saves parsing the topology.
